message.title: Solstad Maritime ASA - Key information relating to Q3 2025 Dividend
message.body:
Skudeneshavn, 30 October 2025

Reference is made to the announcement by Solstad Maritime ASA earlier today,
where the Board of Directors presented the results for the quarter ended 30
September 2025 and announced that it had resolved to distribute a cash dividend
of USD 0.032 per share to its shareholders, totalling approximately USD 15
million, based on the authorization approved by the General Meeting on 23 April
2025. Key information relating to the cash dividend is set out below:

. Dividend amount: USD 0.032 per share

. Declared currency: USD (please note that the dividend will be paid out in NOK)

. Last day of trading in the Solstad Maritime ASA share inclusive of the right
to receive the dividend: 7 November 2025

. Ex-date: 10 November 2025

. Record date: 11 November 2025

. Distribution date: On or about 13 November 2025

. Date of approval: 30 October 2025

Contacts:

Lars Peder Solstad, Chief Executive Officer, +47 91 31 85 85

Kjetil Ramstad, Chief Financial Officer, +47 90 75 94 89

This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the
Euronext Oslo Børs Rule Book II section 4.2.4.
